name: No hardware acceleration · Software simulation directly (Example)
author: ApkStart
description: When Hypervisor Platform is disabled and kernel driver installation is disallowed, hardware-accelerated emulator startup fails immediately. This patch directs ApkStart to use software simulation (-accel off) immediately, avoiding two rounds of timeouts, and sets rendering backend to software to avoid GL initialization failures.

notes: Software simulation is 5-10x slower than hardware acceleration; enabling Virtual Machine Platform in Windows Features is recommended when possible
